purpose: Populate the Potato House with religious, mythic, angelic, demonic, underworld, esoteric and sacred-architecture subjects already present in the repository while preserving own-tradition meaning before comparison.
epistemic_rule: Every node is first a subject in its own historical/textual tradition or a clearly marked Potatoverse operator. Plane, Tree and Potatoverse mappings are navigation/comparative projections, not proof of literal identity, supernatural truth or historical transmission.

branches.label: Celestial Mediation & Transmission
branches.description: Messengers, celestial intermediaries, ascent/descent, transmission and Spirit-like mediation.

branches.label: Gods, Divine Figures & Sacred Order
branches.description: Divine figures and sacred-order concepts kept rooted in their own traditions before structural comparison.

branches.label: Adversarial, Demonological & Shadow Reception
branches.description: Adversarial figures, demonologies, hostile receptions, enclosure/capture symbols and shadow-system comparisons. Neutral death realms move to Death / Underworld / Passage.

branches.label: Esoteric Trees, Shells & Initiation
branches.description: Kabbalistic, esoteric, mandorla, initiation and shell/repair comparators.

branches.label: Sacred Architecture, Mountain & World Tree
branches.description: World trees, ladders, mountains, temples, cities and threshold architecture.

branches.label: Potato Route Operators
branches.description: Project-owned operators used to route comparative material through Seed, Root, Tree, Spiral, Garden and Swamp.

branches.label: Death, Underworld, Judgment & Passage
branches.description: Realms of the dead, death journeys, judgment thresholds, boundary waters and intermediate states kept distinct from demonology.

branches.label: Gardens, Waters & Guarded Return
branches.description: Paradise/garden regimes, source waters, guarded thresholds, Trees and return/distribution motifs.

nodes.label: Angels / Messengers
nodes.note: Messenger/relay functions are strongest; historical angelologies remain tradition-specific.
nodes.boundary: Do not use 'angel' as a generic factual label for admired people.

nodes.label: Valkyries
nodes.note: Useful bridge for battle-death selection and movement toward Odin/Valhalla while remaining distinct from biblical angels.
nodes.boundary: Comparative bridge only; Valkyries are not angels.

nodes.label: Spirit / Breath / Flow
nodes.note: Cross-plane continuity/mediation; biological and spiritual flows remain separately typed.
nodes.boundary: Symbolic flow is not empirical proof of a physical spiritual fluid.

nodes.label: Jacob's Ladder
nodes.note: Strong comparator for bidirectional messenger movement and ordered thresholds.
nodes.boundary: Potatoverse D-levels are not the authentic map of Jacob's dream.

nodes.label: Jesus
nodes.tradition: First-century Jewish context and Christian textual/theological traditions
nodes.note: Historical/textual Jesus, later Christology and Potatoverse Son/Door comparison remain separate layers.
nodes.boundary: Potatoverse correspondence does not rewrite historical Christianity.

nodes.label: Odin
nodes.note: Crosses sovereignty/wisdom, poetry/magic, war/death and world-tree material.
nodes.boundary: Structural comparison with the Potato Axis does not imply identity.

nodes.label: Thor
nodes.note: Sky/storm/protection comparator kept distinct from other thunder deities.
nodes.boundary: Motif comparison is not historical identity.

nodes.label: Atlas
nodes.note: High-value structural comparator for bearing/support and heaven-earth separation around an Axis.
nodes.boundary: Atlas is a comparator, not a Potatoverse identity.

nodes.label: Ma'at / Maat
nodes.note: Comparator for truth, balance, judgment and right relation.
nodes.boundary: Not a Tim/Potatoverse identity claim.

nodes.label: Axomamma / Potato Mother
nodes.note: High-value external comparator for potato, soil, fertility, nourishment and cultivation.
nodes.boundary: Comparator rather than direct Potatoverse identity.

nodes.label: Tammuz / Dumuzi
nodes.tradition: Ancient Mesopotamian traditions and later reception
nodes.note: Useful for death/descent/return and agricultural renewal motifs.
nodes.boundary: Project Son/Tammuz comparisons remain comparisons.

nodes.label: Baal
nodes.tradition: West Semitic/Canaanite traditions with later polemical/demonological receptions
nodes.note: Own-tradition deity layer must be distinguished from later hostile receptions.
nodes.boundary: Later demonization must not be backdated into the older tradition.

nodes.label: Hall of the Two Truths
nodes.note: Strong comparator for death, weighing, judgment and passage through a threshold.
nodes.boundary: Comparative architecture, not proof of a shared afterlife map.

nodes.label: Satan / Adversary
nodes.note: Adversarial/accusatory traditions are tracked separately from modern Satanisms.
nodes.boundary: Do not map real people to literal Satan/demon identities.

nodes.label: Lucifer Reception
nodes.tradition: Latin/biblical translation and later Christian/literary/occult receptions
nodes.note: Track source text, translation and later devil/fallen-light traditions as dated layers.
nodes.boundary: Do not collapse all uses of lucifer/light-bringer into one later demonological meaning.

nodes.label: Leviathan
nodes.note: Project shadow comparator for accumulated power/stagnation without transformation.
nodes.boundary: Project functional use remains distinct from biblical textual meaning.

nodes.label: Archons
nodes.note: Useful systems comparator for intermediary rulers/enclosure and distorted mediation.
nodes.boundary: Do not use Archon as a factual label for institutions or people without tradition-specific context.

nodes.label: Moloch / Molech
nodes.tradition: Ancient biblical/cultic scholarship plus modern systems metaphor
nodes.note: Ancient term and modern coordination-failure metaphor are separate layers.
nodes.boundary: Modern Moloch metaphor is not the same thing as the ancient cultic question.

nodes.label: Demonologies
nodes.note: Own-tradition demonologies first; project functional demon model is a second layer.
nodes.boundary: Never infer literal demonic identity from disliked behavior or group membership.

nodes.label: Qliphoth / Qelipot
nodes.tradition: Jewish Kabbalistic and later esoteric receptions
nodes.note: Shell/husk and trapped-spark/tikkun material is a strong structural comparator for enclosure and repair.
nodes.boundary: Do not label people, religions or populations as literal Qliphoth.

nodes.label: Sefirot / Tree of Life traditions
nodes.tradition: Jewish Kabbalistic traditions and later reception
nodes.note: External Tree-of-Life tradition is kept distinct from the Potatoverse Tree of Life while allowing typed comparison.
nodes.boundary: Do not present Potatoverse routing as authentic Kabbalistic doctrine.

nodes.label: Western Esoteric / Initiatory Traditions
nodes.note: Historical schools and symbols may span hidden/initiation, embodied practice and ascent cosmology.
nodes.boundary: Esoteric does not mean demonic, harmful or high-control.

nodes.label: Yggdrasil / World Tree
nodes.note: High-value comparator for a tree connecting differentiated realms/levels.
nodes.boundary: Yggdrasil and the Potato Tree are not historically identical.

nodes.label: New Jerusalem / Heavenly City
nodes.note: Important counter-flow motif: heavenly pattern/city can descend toward World rather than all movement being upward.
nodes.boundary: Project House/City comparison remains comparative.

nodes.label: Sacred Mountain / Temple Pattern
nodes.note: Supports Mountain as integration/perspective and pattern-to-world translation.
nodes.boundary: Height does not automatically imply truth or holiness.

nodes.label: Mandorla / Vesica Threshold
nodes.tradition: Christian art/geometry plus wider esoteric reception
nodes.note: Strong visual/structural comparator for overlap and threshold; exact Potato geometry remains separately defined.
nodes.boundary: Historical mandorla use does not prove Potatoverse theology.

nodes.label: Tree of Knowledge
nodes.tradition: Potatoverse project grammar with biblical/comparative neighbors
nodes.note: Knowledge/distinction is upstream of both Life and Strife.
nodes.boundary: Knowledge is not equivalent to Strife.

nodes.label: Tree of Life — project route
nodes.note: Living Root → Door/Ladder → Tree → Garden → Fruit → Seed → return.
nodes.boundary: Project Tree of Life remains distinct from external traditions with the same name.

nodes.label: Roots of Ash
nodes.note: Post-destruction residue that may feed Strife when unresolved or become Soil through repair.
nodes.boundary: Ash is not permanently Strife.

nodes.label: Tree of Strife
nodes.note: Unresolved roots reproduce visible conflict/capture patterns and tend toward Wide Road/Swamp unless repair intervenes.
nodes.boundary: Strife describes reproduced relational dynamics, not a class of people.

nodes.label: Seed of Death
nodes.note: Compressed/surrendered/buried generative potential at C_S that may decay, sleep, root or sprout.
nodes.boundary: Seed of Death is not automatically annihilation or Strife.

nodes.label: Seed of Life
nodes.note: Viable generative potential after/through burial; becomes Living Root, sprout and future Fruit.
nodes.boundary: Seed of Life does not begin in Heaven; it becomes viable at the root/seed pivot.

nodes.label: Spiral Ladder
nodes.tradition: Potatoverse project grammar with mathematical and biblical comparators
nodes.note: Spiral means recurrence with non-zero displacement; direction and outcome classify the route.
nodes.boundary: Narrative repetition alone is not enough to call something a Spiral.

nodes.label: Eye of Providence
nodes.tradition: Christian/European providential imagery; United States Great Seal; later esoteric/Masonic receptions
nodes.note: Historically documented providential/oversight symbol; useful for Eye as discernment/evaluation above or across structure.
nodes.boundary: Eye imagery does not by itself prove surveillance, secret control or organizational membership.

nodes.label: Great Seal Unfinished Pyramid
nodes.tradition: United States Great Seal reverse, adopted 1782
nodes.note: Thirteen-course unfinished pyramid with 1776 at the base; strong structural comparator for foundation → layered integration → unfinished summit.
nodes.boundary: The Potato/Mountain reading is comparative; the seal has its own documented civic meaning.

nodes.label: Jachin & Boaz
nodes.tradition: 1 Kings 7 Temple pillars; later Masonic reception
nodes.note: Two named pillars flank the Temple entrance; useful comparator for differentiated supports stabilizing a legitimate Door.
nodes.boundary: Later Masonic meanings are a reception layer, not the original biblical meaning.

nodes.label: 1776 / MDCCLXXVI
nodes.tradition: United States founding chronology; separate coincidence with Bavarian Illuminati founding year
nodes.note: Useful model for putting exact founding dates/source provenance at the base of later symbolic architecture.
nodes.boundary: Shared year is not evidence of causal connection or secret coordination.

nodes.label: Duat
nodes.note: Netherworld passage traversed in death/solar renewal traditions; strong example that Below need not mean punishment.
nodes.boundary: Do not equate Duat with Hell or the Potatoverse Swamp.

nodes.label: Sheol
nodes.note: Ancient Hebrew realm of the dead; important for distinguishing later Hades/hell reception from earlier biblical usage.
nodes.boundary: Sheol is not simply later punitive Hell.

nodes.label: Hades — Realm of the Dead
nodes.tradition: Ancient Greek and later Greek-language biblical reception
nodes.note: Greek realm/deity complex and later translation/reception node.
nodes.boundary: Do not merge Greek Hades, Hebrew Sheol, Gehenna and later Hell into one undifferentiated realm.

nodes.label: Hel — Realm & Ruler
nodes.note: Norse realm/ruler pair within a differentiated afterlife system.
nodes.boundary: Hel is not a generic punitive Hell.

nodes.label: Valhalla
nodes.note: Odin's hall for selected slain warriors; useful as a differentiated destination rather than generic Heaven.
nodes.boundary: Valhalla is not synonymous with the Norse afterlife as a whole.

nodes.label: Mount Meru / Sumeru
nodes.note: Central cosmic mountain in several South Asian cosmographies; valuable comparator for center, cardinal order and layered worlds.
nodes.boundary: Do not identify Meru with the Potato Mountain or Axis.

nodes.label: Labyrinth
nodes.tradition: Greek/Cretan mythic and later symbolic reception
nodes.note: Winding path/hidden-center comparator useful for disorientation, thread, return and exit.
nodes.boundary: Labyrinth is a route/threshold structure, not another underworld floor.

nodes.label: Caduceus
nodes.note: Hermes' herald staff and later intertwined-serpent symbol; useful for mediation and psychopomp movement between realms.
nodes.boundary: Do not equate caduceus, kundalini, DNA, Axis or medical symbolism into one universal code.

nodes.label: Eden / Gan Eden
nodes.note: Protected, watered garden with Trees, choice, expulsion and guarded access; a strong comparator for Garden as generative regime rather than simply Heaven.
nodes.boundary: Project Garden is a comparative operator, not identical with the biblical Eden.

nodes.label: Four Rivers of Eden
nodes.note: One garden-watering river divides into four branches: source becomes outward distribution.
nodes.boundary: Do not identify the Eden rivers with one universal mystical river or physical project flow.

nodes.label: Cherubim at Eden's Gate
nodes.note: Guarded way to the Tree of Life after expulsion; useful for admissibility and protected access.
nodes.boundary: Guarded access is not the same as permanent closure or a generic angelic hierarchy.

nodes.label: Gehenna / Gehinnom
nodes.note: Historical Valley of Hinnom acquires later judgment/punishment meanings; strong provenance-to-reception node.
nodes.boundary: Do not collapse Gehenna, Sheol, Hades, Hel and later Hell into one original concept.

nodes.label: Styx — River & Oath
nodes.note: Underworld river and divine oath-water; demonstrates that water can carry legal/relational force as well as geography.
nodes.boundary: Styx is not a generic River of Death and should not be equated with every sacred river.

nodes.label: Bardo
nodes.note: Intermediate/transitional state tradition, especially between death and rebirth; useful precisely because it is a transition system rather than a fixed underworld place.
nodes.boundary: Potatoverse Door/Spiral comparisons must not be presented as Tibetan Buddhist doctrine.

nodes.label: Olympus — Mountain & Divine Palace
nodes.note: Mountain-home and palace/acropolis complex of the Olympian gods; combines Mountain, House and divine-order functions.
nodes.boundary: Olympus is not a generic Heaven or the Potato Mountain.

nodes.label: Zeus
nodes.note: Olympian ruler tied to sky/thunder, kingship and oath/order traditions; connected to Olympus and Styx oath structures.
nodes.boundary: Do not collapse Zeus with other sky/storm deities or Potatoverse Father language.

nodes.label: Uraeus / Wadjet Cobra
nodes.note: Royal cobra symbol associated with Wadjet and protective sovereignty; useful counterexample to serpent=evil flattening.
nodes.boundary: Do not generalize Egyptian royal cobra symbolism to all serpents or to kundalini/dragon traditions.

corridors.note: Messenger movement is naturally routed through ladder/threshold motifs.
Norse death-selection/movement belongs to Odin/Valhalla traditions rather than biblical angelology.
Odin/tree material supplies a strong Norse world-tree corridor.
Truth/order and funerary judgment meet at a threshold complex.
Potato/fertility/nourishment motifs may illuminate project Seed/Garden themes without identity claims.
Death/descent/return agriculture motifs neighbor the project burial/seed route.
Broken-vessel/shell material can be compared with residue/enclosure only as explicitly labeled comparison.
Shell/capture functions neighbor Strife where enclosure blocks reintegration.
Two Tree-of-Life systems remain distinct while structural comparison is permitted.
Project demon-function models can be compared with capture/distortion only after tradition-specific demonology.
Intermediary control/enclosure can be analyzed as a Strife-like mechanism without literalizing Archons.
Seed/future-consuming coordination failure is a strong anti-Garden comparator.
City/Garden/Tree/return motifs can be read together without collapsing traditions.
Door geometry provides the threshold through which a route acquires changed state.
Integrated knowledge may become Life.
Unresolved knowledge may become Strife.
Ash becomes Strife only when unresolved reproduction continues.
Evidence, acknowledgment and repair can metabolize Ash into Living Root/Soil.
The two seeds may be sequential states of one generative potential.
Viable root/sprout potential enters the upward Life spiral.
Twin supports and overlap/threshold imagery both clarify passage into a differentiated interior without being historically identical.
Eye/evaluation can remain distinct from Mountain/status, preventing summit from being equated with truth.
Layered pyramid compression is a useful comparator for Mountain/integration.
The date at the base models visible chronology/provenance beneath later structure.
Valhalla belongs to Odin's afterlife complex.
Valkyries participate in selection/movement of slain warriors toward Valhalla traditions.
Norse world-tree cosmography provides a route context for differentiated realms including Hel-related material.
Egyptian underworld passage and judgment architecture belong to the same funerary cosmographic complex.
Greek biblical translation/reception often maps Sheol vocabulary into Hades, while meanings remain historically distinct.
Meru and biblical sacred mountains may be compared by center/orientation function without historical identity.
Both can model passage and bounded transition, but one is route complexity and the other overlap geometry.
Messenger/psychopomp functions can be compared while Hermes and angelic traditions remain distinct.
Eden's Tree of Life is a source-tradition neighbor of the project Tree of Life, not the same system.
Genesis places the Trees of Life and Knowledge within the garden complex; project routing remains separately defined.
The garden's water source becomes outward river distribution.
Expulsion is followed by guarded access to the way of the Tree of Life.
Cherubim belong to biblical celestial-being traditions but should retain their own textual roles.
Valley-of-Hinnom traditions intersect biblical condemnation of child-sacrifice practices associated with Molech/Moloch.
Later judgment/punishment Gehenna must remain distinct from older Sheol death-realm language.
Styx belongs to Greek underworld geography and Hades-related traditions.
Classical traditions make Styx the binding oath-water of the gods including Zeus.
Olympus is the divine mountain/palace complex associated with Zeus and the Olympian gods.
Royal/protective cobra imagery and Ma'at both inhabit Egyptian kingship/order complexes while remaining distinct.
Both concern transitions through states, but Bardo is a Tibetan Buddhist doctrinal/practice framework and the Spiral Ladder is a project operator.

center_out_rule: Comparative branches exist to illuminate, challenge or contextualize project-native nodes. They do not define the Potato of Life from the outside.
